text:
leah: Huge thanks to @josh and @teri — spilled a latte all over my keyboard right before the demo and they ran an emergency rescue. saved my laptop and my dignity. :flushed: 
josh: not all heroes wear capes, some wear nitrile gloves. caffeine casualty report: 1 keyboard, 0 demos ruined. :sunglasses:
teri: quick disassembly, rice packet, and a towel triage did the trick. also grabbed a spare keyboard from the stash in the supply closet.
alex: pizza incoming for the rescue squad? nominate for morale snacks and buy-back insurance. :pizza:
maria: signed — ordering a small party pizza. sending Venmo to cover. thanks for the quick reflexes @josh @teri.
facilities-bot: Facilities note: spill cleanup kit restocked at supply closet shelf B. Please log any single-use items taken.
it-pony: IT delivered a loaner keyboard in 8 minutes and imaged a temporary profile so leah could finish the demo. Filing a small kudos ticket for fast turnaround.
leah: demo actually went smoother after the drama. extra loud applause for the team. :clap::clap::clap: I'll add a sticky note on my monitor: "Do not trust leah before coffee" :coffee:
josh: photo evidence attached: <keyboard_after_triage.jpg>  looks surprisingly heroic. :camera_with_flash:
teri: small PSA — if you pour liquids near electronics, remove battery asap and call help. we might add a tiny tip card near the coffee station.
alex: pizza ETA 15 min. toppings: half margherita, half veggie for the healers. anyone allergic to nuts?
maria: no nuts here. i'll also bring napkins and hand sanitizer.
leah: officially adding two kudos — one for "quick hands" (josh) and one for "steady nerves" (teri). recording in the weekly kudos doc.
it-pony: Kudos recorded: ticket #K-2371 assigned to josh, teri. Also flagged for small reward budget.
facilities-bot: Reminder: Please log accidental spills using the Incident form so we can track recurring hotspots.
josh: night shift of tiny emergencies remains undefeated. pizza party at 3pm in the kitchen. be there or be dry.
teri: saving demos and keyboards since 2024. thanks team.
maria: love seeing quick teamwork like this  makes all the difference. see you at pizza.
leah: couldn't have done it without you all. seriously grateful. :heart:
